definition: a person who gathers many things of one kind
description: A smiling young woman with a black bob and fringe, a mustard cardigan and a long olive dress stands beside a tall wooden-framed standing mirror. Next to her, white shelves are crowded from floor to ceiling with dozens of old porcelain teapots with painted flowers. She touches a teapot on a high shelf, then turns and spreads her arms proudly towards the shelves. Two friends laugh on a sofa behind her, more teapots stand on a table, and open cardboard boxes with bubble wrap sit on the floor.

en.question: What does the standing woman collect?

de.answer: Sie sammelt alte Teekannen aus Porzellan.
de.question: Was sammelt die stehende Frau?
